context.passage:
KIMBERLEY CONSULTING GEOENGINEERS
Resource Assessment
Client: Springbok Concrete Suppliers LLC
Property examined: Bhule Gravel Quarry
Purpose: To determine how long Springbok Concrete Suppliers LLC can continue mining
the Bhule Gravel Quarry pits for gravel
Dates: 15-19 July
Summary of main findings of the assessment team: - [1] —. We examined the
availability of high-quality gravel in and around the two main quarry pits at Bhule Gravel
Quer analyzi, we to sa ares, from sevinal diatre caven are nd the le gravel art it.
or around the North Quarry pit. — [2] —. Therefore, we recommend ending this operation
within the next year. In addition, it is not cost-effective to mine the gravel at the North
Quarry pit even though it is closer to the processing plant than the South Quarry pit is.
In contrast, there are extensive amounts of gravel still to be mined in the South Quarry pit.
The samples we retrieved by drilling indicate that the mineable gravel deposits extend
800 metres south of the pit and to a depth of 15 metres. If gravel continues to be mined at
the current rate, we estimate that the mining operation at the South Quarry pit can be
sustained for another three years. — [3] —. The cost of the operation will gradually
increase because it will be necessary to dig deeper. Nevertheless, we believe the operation
will remain profitable. - [4] -.
Assessment prepared by: Gertruida Botha and Moeketsi Mosala
